annotations.title: Airdrop points per dollar of fees, this week (Pro, 0.05 USDC)

description: PAID: 0.05 USDC on Base per call, via x402 (no account; an x402-enabled client pays automatically). For every perp DEX with a published weekly points pool: the share of this week's pool that $1M of your volume would earn (from the venue's live 7-day volume) and what that volume costs in fees at the entry tier, so you farm where a dollar of fees buys the most. A theoretical maximum, said so.
